justification: Nobody's sweating George this week - 7-3 outscored by 48 is a typo wearing a record, and I'm rolling out the same guys who just hung 142 on Gary. Burrow's the best quarterback in this building, period, don't care what Mahomes or Ward are doing rotting on my own bench, that's just depth I don't need to explain. Henry and Hubbard both get the ball in real offenses, Chase just dropped 231 yards on a human being, and Rice stays. Freiermuth earned his spot with a touchdown last week off a zero-dollar pickup - I don't bench a guy who just delivered, that's not how loyalty works - but Loveland's back off his bye and I like having two tight ends too much to leave him glued to the pine, so he slides into FLEX over Dobbins, projections be damned, I feel it. Loop's stuck on IR and I don't have another kicker on this entire roster, so he starts because the alternative is nobody, not because I like it - and LV's defense rides regardless. George, enjoy the view from the other sideline.
